itineraries.title: Cultural Triangle Express
itineraries.whyYouWillLoveIt: Perfect for travelers short on time, this whirlwind tour hits Sri Lanka's must-see ancient sites. You'll climb an iconic rock fortress and visit sacred temples, experiencing two UNESCO World Heritage spots in just a long weekend.

activities.title: Drive to Cultural Triangle
activities.description: Drive ~4 hours from Colombo to Sri Lanka's Cultural Triangle.

activities.title: Dambulla Cave Temple
activities.description: A hillside complex of gilded Buddhas and murals. Allow ~1 hour for the steep climb.

activities.title: Leisure at Sigiriya
activities.description: Stay in a jungle lodge or cozy guesthouse near Sigiriya for an authentic village atmosphere.

activities.title: Climb Sigiriya Rock Fortress
activities.description: Climb the Lion Rock fortress (1–1.5 hour climb) to explore ancient palace ruins and take in the 360° jungle views.

activities.title: Transfer to Kandy
activities.description: Transfer ~3 hours to Kandy, the hill-country capital.

activities.title: Temple of the Tooth Relic
activities.description: Visit the Temple of the Tooth Relic during the evening puja ceremony where Buddha's sacred tooth relic is venerated with drums and incense.

activities.title: Kandy Lake Stroll
activities.description: Take a morning stroll around Kandy Lake and browse the local market for souvenirs.

activities.title: Royal Botanical Gardens
activities.description: Visit the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya for a relaxing walk among orchids and spice trees.

activities.title: Return to Colombo
activities.description: Travel ~3.5 hours back to Colombo by private car or train.

customizationNotes: Take the train or intercity bus for Sigiriya-Kandy leg (cheaper but add an extra hour)
Catch a colorful cultural dance performance in Kandy at night
Stop at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage on the way back to Colombo

itineraries.title: Southern Beaches & Wildlife
itineraries.whyYouWillLoveIt: A perfect mix of relaxation and adventure, this itinerary takes you from colonial forts to palm-fringed beaches and a wildlife safari. In under a week, enjoy Sri Lanka's south coast sunshine, go whale watching, and spot elephants or leopards in the wild.

activities.title: Drive to Galle
activities.description: Head south ~2 hours on the expressway to Galle.

activities.title: Explore Galle Fort
activities.description: Explore Galle Fort, a 17th-century Dutch fortress town with charming cobblestone streets, cafes, and colonial architecture.

activities.title: Sunset on Ramparts
activities.description: Walk the ramparts at sunset for gorgeous ocean views.

activities.title: Unawatuna Beach
activities.description: Unwind on the nearby Unawatuna Beach with a swim or snorkel.

activities.title: Drive to Mirissa
activities.description: Drive ~1 hour to Mirissa, a lively beach town.

activities.title: Coconut Tree Hill
activities.description: Climb Coconut Tree Hill for panoramic views of the coastline.

activities.title: Whale Watching
activities.description: Rise early for a whale watching tour (Nov–Apr) from Mirissa's harbor. A 4-hour boat excursion gives you a chance to spot blue whales and dolphins.

activities.title: Transfer to Yala
activities.description: Travel ~3 hours east to the Yala National Park vicinity.

activities.title: Yala Safari
activities.description: Enjoy a dawn Jeep safari in Yala National Park. Watch for elephants, crocodiles, deer, and the elusive leopard.

activities.title: Return to Colombo
activities.description: 5–6 hours drive back to Colombo with rest stops.

activities.title: Colombo City Tour
activities.description: See the Gangaramaya Temple, Pettah Market, and colonial buildings in the Fort district.

activities.title: Galle Face Green
activities.description: Stroll along Galle Face Green promenade to watch the locals fly kites and grab a street-food snack.

customizationNotes: Swap Yala for Udawalawe National Park for guaranteed elephants
If visiting May–Oct when whales are off-season, spend the morning surfing in Weligama

itineraries.title: Cultural Heart of Sri Lanka
itineraries.whyYouWillLoveIt: Immerse yourself in Sri Lanka's rich history on this one-week journey. You'll explore the ancient cities of the Cultural Triangle and the sacred sites of Kandy, balanced with a taste of the hill country. It's a heritage-focused route featuring five UNESCO World Heritage Sites in 7 days.

activities.title: Drive to Anuradhapura
activities.description: Travel ~5 hours north to the ancient capital of Anuradhapura.

activities.title: Sri Maha Bodhi & Ruvanvelisaya
activities.description: Visit the sacred Bodhi Tree and the massive white Ruvanvelisaya Dagoba, one of Sri Lanka's most revered stupas.

activities.title: Explore Anuradhapura Ruins
activities.description: Cycle through the ancient city ruins including Jetavanaramaya, Abhayagiri, and the Moonstone path.

activities.title: Drive to Sigiriya
activities.description: Travel ~2 hours to Sigiriya and check into a jungle lodge.

activities.title: Climb Sigiriya Rock Fortress
activities.description: Ascend the iconic Lion Rock to explore ancient frescoes, mirror wall, and palace ruins at the summit.

activities.title: Polonnaruwa Ancient City
activities.description: Explore the medieval capital by bicycle - see the Gal Vihara Buddha statues, Royal Palace, and Vatadage.

activities.title: Dambulla Cave Temple
activities.description: Climb to the Golden Temple complex with five caves filled with Buddha statues and ancient murals.

activities.title: Transfer to Kandy
activities.description: Scenic 3-hour drive through spice gardens and villages to Kandy.

activities.title: Temple of the Tooth
activities.description: Attend the evening puja ceremony at the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic.

activities.title: Royal Botanical Gardens
activities.description: Wander through 150 acres of tropical gardens including the orchid house and spice garden.

activities.title: Kandy Lake & Market
activities.description: Stroll around Kandy Lake and explore the bustling local market for handicrafts and gems.

activities.title: Cultural Dance Show
activities.description: Watch a traditional Kandyan dance performance with fire walking finale.

activities.title: Scenic Train to Ella
activities.description: Board the iconic blue train for one of the world's most beautiful train journeys through tea country.

activities.title: Ella Town
activities.description: Arrive in Ella and enjoy the laid-back mountain town atmosphere with cafes and stunning views.

activities.title: Nine Arch Bridge
activities.description: Walk to the famous colonial-era railway bridge for sunrise photos with passing trains.

activities.title: Little Adam's Peak
activities.description: Short hike through tea plantations to panoramic views of Ella Gap.

activities.title: Return to Colombo
activities.description: 5-hour drive back to Colombo via the expressway.

customizationNotes: For a slower pace, skip Nuwara Eliya and spend Day 5–6 in Kandy and surrounds
Take a day trip to Anuradhapura or a trek in the Knuckles Range
